title: The hat, the football game and the comeback
lede: Four commercials from the three years in which Zima was heavily advertised, a local news item on the 2017 return and one later retrospective. Airing years for the commercials come from the uploaders unless stated.

videos.title: “Zomething different,” the launch commercial
videos.caption: The black-hatted pitchman of the national launch campaign, made by Foote, Cone & Belding.[^12] The uploader dates it to 1994. It was posted in November 2008, weeks after production ended.

videos.title: Zima Clearmalt commercial from the regional rollout
videos.caption: Dated 1993 by the uploader, which would place it in the year Zima was sold in about a third of the country.[^1] We could not confirm the airing date independently.

videos.title: “Zomething in common”
videos.caption: The black-and-white football spot from the campaign that replaced the pitchman. The uploader labels it 1994; Westword described it as the new campaign in September 1995.[^12]

videos.title: Zima Gold commercial
videos.caption: Advertising for the amber, 5.4% version aimed at men. Gold went national in May 1995 and was withdrawn that summer.[^12][^3]

videos.title: TMJ4 News: “MillerCoors plans to bring back Zima”
videos.caption: A Milwaukee station’s short item, posted February 22, 2017, five days after MillerCoors confirmed the relaunch.[^23]

videos.title: Weird History Food: “Zima Was Popular in the 90s, Until People Tasted It”
videos.caption: A twelve-minute independent retrospective published in May 2022. Its figures are the uploader’s; ours are in the sections above.
